items.source: since 7.0.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起。

items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of the SpringExtension and JUnit Jupiter
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，推荐使用 SpringExtension 和 JUnit Jupiter。

items.source: Extension of AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor which implements BeanFactoryAware, adds exposure of the original target class for each proxied bean (AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE), and participates in an externally enforced target-class mode for any given bean (AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE).
items.translation: 扩展了实现 BeanFactoryAware 的 AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor，为每个代理 bean 暴露原始目标类（AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE），并参与任何给定 bean 的外部强制目标类模式（AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE）。

items.source: The default MessageHandlerMethodFactory implementation creating an InvocableHandlerMethod with the necessary HandlerMethodArgumentResolver instances to detect and process most of the use cases defined by MessageMapping.
items.translation: 默认 `MessageHandlerMethodFactory` 实现会创建一个 InvocableHandlerMethod，并包含必要的 HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 实例，以检测和处理 MessageMapping 定义的大多数用例。

items.source: Extension of MessageMappingMessageHandler to handle RSocket requests with @MessageMapping and @ConnectMapping methods, also supporting use of @RSocketExchange.
items.translation: 扩展 MessageMappingMessageHandler 以处理带有 @MessageMapping 和 @ConnectMapping 方法的 RSocket 请求，同时也支持使用 @RSocketExchange。

items.source: An extension of RequestMappingInfoHandlerMapping that creates RequestMappingInfo instances from type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations.
items.translation: 一个扩展了RequestMappingInfoHandlerMapping的类，它从类型级别和方法级别的@RequestMapping及@HttpExchange注解创建RequestMappingInfo实例。

items.source: Creates RequestMappingInfo instances from type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations in @Controller classes.
items.translation: 从 `@Controller` 类中的类型级和方法级@RequestMapping及@HttpExchange注解创建 RequestMappingInfo 实例。

items.source: Specialization of PlaceholderConfigurerSupport that resolves ${...} placeholders within bean definition property values and @Value annotations against the current Spring Environment and its set of PropertySources.
items.translation: `PlaceholderConfigurerSupport` 类的特化版本，用于在当前 Spring Environment 及其一组 PropertySources 中解析 bean 定义属性值内的 ${...} 占位符以及 `@Value` 注解。

items.source: Simple BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementation that registers custom Scope(s) with the containing ConfigurableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 简单的BeanFactoryPostProcessor实现，用于向包含的ConfigurableBeanFactory注册自定义的Scope(s)。

items.source: CacheManager implementation that lazily builds ConcurrentMapCache instances for each ConcurrentMapCacheManager.getCache(String) request.
items.translation: 实现CacheManager接口，该实现会为每个ConcurrentMapCacheManager.getCache(String)请求懒加载构建ConcurrentMapCache实例。

items.source: Interceptor that publishes an ApplicationEvent to all ApplicationListeners registered with an ApplicationEventPublisher after each successful method invocation.
items.translation: Interceptor 会在每次成功的方法调用后，向所有已注册到 ApplicationEventPublisher 的 ApplicationListeners 发布一个 ApplicationEvent。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that passes the context's default LoadTimeWeaver to beans that implement the LoadTimeWeaverAware interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 实现，它将上下文中的默认 LoadTimeWeaver 传递给实现了 LoadTimeWeaverAware 接口的 Bean。

items.source: An implementation of DestinationResolver that interprets a destination name as the bean name of a MessageChannel and looks up the bean in the configured BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `DestinationResolver` 的类，它将目标名称解释为 `MessageChannel` 的 Bean 名称，并在配置的 `BeanFactory` 中查找该 Bean。

items.source: This is the central class for jakarta.validation (JSR-303) setup in a Spring application context: It bootstraps a jakarta.validation.ValidationFactory and exposes it through the Spring Validator interface as well as through the JSR-303 Validator interface and the ValidatorFactory interface itself.
items.translation: 这是用于在 Spring 应用程序上下文中设置 `jakarta.validation` (JSR-303) 的中心类：它引导启动一个 `jakarta.validation.ValidationFactory`，并通过 Spring Validator 接口、JSR-303 `Validator` 接口以及 `ValidatorFactory` 接口本身将其暴露出来。

items.source: FactoryBean for HttpServiceProxyRegistry responsible for initializing HttpServiceGroups and creating the HTTP Service client proxies for each group.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于 HttpServiceProxyRegistry，负责初始化 HttpServiceGroups 并为每个组创建 HTTP Service 客户端代理。

items.source: Extension of AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter that supports @RequestMapping annotated HandlerMethods.
items.translation: 扩展了支持带有 `@RequestMapping` 注解的 `HandlerMethods` 的 `AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter`。

items.source: A WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport extension that detects beans of type WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer and delegates to all of them allowing callback style customization of the configuration provided in WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport.
items.translation: 一个 `WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport` 扩展，用于检测类型为 `WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer` 的 Bean，并委托给所有这些 Bean，从而允许以回调方式自定义在 `WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport` 中提供的配置。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any @Configuration class that wishes to be injected with the AnnotationMetadata of the @Configuration class that imported it.
items.translation: 任何希望被注入导入它的@Configuration类的AnnotationMetadata的@Configuration类必须实现的接口。

items.source: Complete implementation of the AutowireCandidateResolver strategy interface, providing support for qualifier annotations as well as for lazy resolution driven by the Lazy annotation in the context.annotation package.
items.translation: 完整实现AutowireCandidateResolver策略接口，提供对限定符注解以及由context.annotation包中的Lazy注解驱动的懒加载的支持。

items.source: Specialization of AsyncExecutionInterceptor that delegates method execution to an Executor based on the Async annotation.
items.translation: `AsyncExecutionInterceptor` 类的特化版本，该委托方法执行给基于 `Async` 注解的 `Executor`。

items.source: A subclass of SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler to provide support for ControllerAdvice with global @MessageExceptionHandler methods.
items.translation: 一个 `SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler` 的子类，用于支持带有全局 `@MessageExceptionHandler` 方法的 ControllerAdvice。

items.source: in favor of using just PathPatternParser; when HandlerMappingIntrospector.allHandlerMappingsUsePathPatternParser() returns true, it is sufficient to use that to align with handler mappings.
items.translation: 倾向于仅使用 `PathPatternParser`；当 `HandlerMappingIntrospector.allHandlerMappingsUsePathPatternParser()` 返回 true 时，使用它来与处理器映射保持一致就足够了。

items.source: Provides implementations of Message along with a MessageBuilder and MessageHeaderAccessor for building and working with messages and message headers, as well as various MessageChannel implementations and channel interceptor support.
items.translation: 提供 `Message` 的实现，以及用于构建和处理消息和消息头的 MessageBuilder 与 MessageHeaderAccessor，同时还提供了各种 `MessageChannel` 实现及通道拦截器支持。

items.source: TransportHandler implementation classes as well as a concrete SockJsService.
items.translation: `TransportHandler` 实现类以及具体的 `SockJsService`。

items.source: FactoryBean implementation that locates a Method on a specified bean.
items.translation: FactoryBean 实现，用于在指定的 bean 上定位一个 Method。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that locates the aspect from the BeanFactory using a configured bean name.
items.translation: 实现 `AspectInstanceFactory`，该接口使用配置的 Bean 名称从`BeanFactory` 中定位切面。

items.source: Base class for BeanPostProcessor implementations that apply a Spring AOP Advisor to specific beans.
items.translation: 适用于将 Spring AOPAdvisor 应用于特定 Bean 的 BeanPostProcessor 实现的基础类。

items.source: FactoryBean implementation that builds an AOP proxy based on beans in a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: FactoryBean 实现，用于基于 Spring BeanFactory 中的 bean 构建 AOP 代理。

items.source: Base class for TargetSource implementations that are based on a Spring BeanFactory, delegating to Spring-managed bean instances.
items.translation: 基于 SpringBeanFactory的TargetSource实现类的基类，委托给 Spring 管理的 Bean 实例。

items.source: TargetSource that lazily accesses a singleton bean from a BeanFactory.
items.translation: TargetSource 可延迟从 BeanFactory 访问单例 Bean。

items.source: Simple TargetSource implementation, freshly obtaining the specified target bean from its containing Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 简单的TargetSource实现，从包含它的 Spring BeanFactory中获取指定的目标 Bean。

items.source: AutowireCandidateResolver implementation that matches bean definition qualifiers against qualifier annotations on the field or parameter to be autowired.
items.translation: 匹配 Bean 定义限定符与要自动注入的字段或参数上的限定符注解的AutowireCandidateResolver实现。

items.source: FactoryBean for easy configuration of a ConcurrentMapCache when used within a Spring container.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于在 Spring 容器内轻松配置 ConcurrentMapCache。

items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor used for bootstrapping processing of @Configuration classes.
items.translation: 用于引导处理 `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` 的`@Configuration` 类。

items.source: Registers EventListener methods as individual ApplicationListener instances.
items.translation: 将 `EventListener` 方法注册为单独的 `ApplicationListener` 实例。

items.source: Spring-specific MessageSource implementation that accesses resource bundles using specified basenames, participating in the Spring ApplicationContext's resource loading.
items.translation: 使用指定的基名访问资源包并参与 Spring ApplicationContext 资源加载的特定于 Spring 的 MessageSource 实现。

items.source: Formats fields annotated with the DateTimeFormat annotation using a DateFormatter.
items.translation: 使用 `DateFormatter` 格式化带有 `DateTimeFormat` 注解的字段。

items.source: A ConversionService implementation designed to be configured as a FormatterRegistry.
items.translation: 一个设计为可配置为FormatterRegistry的ConversionService实现。

items.source: DataSourceLookup implementation based on a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于 SpringBeanFactory 的DataSourceLookup实现。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with JmsListener to be invoked by a JMS message listener container created under the cover by a JmsListenerContainerFactory according to the attributes of the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有JmsListener注解的方法，以便由在幕后通过JmsListenerContainerFactory创建的 JMS 消息监听器容器根据该注解的属性进行调用。

items.source: Helper bean for registering JmsListenerEndpoint with a JmsListenerEndpointRegistry.
items.translation: 用于将JmsListenerEndpoint注册到JmsListenerEndpointRegistry的辅助 Bean。

items.source: DestinationResolver implementation based on a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于 SpringBeanFactory 的DestinationResolver实现。

items.source: Extension of AbstractMethodMessageHandler for reactive, non-blocking handling of messages via @MessageMapping methods.
items.translation: 支持通过 `@MessageMapping` 方法以响应式、非阻塞方式处理消息的 `AbstractMethodMessageHandler` 扩展。

items.source: A handler for messages delegating to @MessageMapping and @SubscribeMapping annotated methods.
items.translation: 用于委托给由 `@MessageMapping` 和 `@SubscribeMapping` 注解的方法的消息处理器。

items.source: A "simple" message broker that recognizes the message types defined in SimpMessageType, keeps track of subscriptions with the help of a SubscriptionRegistry, and sends messages to subscribers.
items.translation: 一个“简单”的消息代理，能够识别在 SimpMessageType 中定义的消息类型，借助 SubscriptionRegistry 跟踪订阅，并将消息发送给订阅者。

items.source: PlatformTransactionManager implementation for a single Hibernate SessionFactory.
items.translation: PlatformTransactionManager 实现，用于单个 Hibernate SessionFactory。

items.source: ConnectionFactoryLookup implementation based on a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于 SpringBeanFactory 的ConnectionFactoryLookup实现。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a concurrency interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @ConcurrencyLimit.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@ConcurrencyLimit注解的 bean 方法应用并发拦截器。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a retry interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @Retryable.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@Retryable注解的 bean 方法应用重试拦截器。

items.source: A Spring FactoryBean for creating a Quartz CronTrigger instance, supporting bean-style usage for trigger configuration.
items.translation: 用于创建 Quartz CronTrigger 实例的 Spring FactoryBean，支持以 Bean 样式配置触发器。

items.source: A Spring FactoryBean for creating a Quartz JobDetail instance, supporting bean-style usage for JobDetail configuration.
items.translation: 用于创建 Quartz JobDetail 实例的 Spring FactoryBean，支持以 Bean 方式配置 JobDetail。

items.source: A Spring FactoryBean for creating a Quartz SimpleTrigger instance, supporting bean-style usage for trigger configuration.
items.translation: 用于创建 Quartz SimpleTrigger 实例的 Spring FactoryBean，支持以 Bean 方式配置触发器。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that handles ScriptFactory definitions, replacing each factory with the actual scripted Java object generated by it.
items.translation: 处理 `ScriptFactory` 定义的、将每个工厂替换为由其生成的实际脚本化 Java 对象的`BeanPostProcessor`。

items.source: BeanFactoryInitializer that eagerly initializes DynamicPropertyRegistrar beans.
items.translation: BeanFactoryInitializer 会急切初始化 DynamicPropertyRegistrar 的 Bean。

items.source: Abstract base test class which integrates the Spring TestContext Framework with explicit ApplicationContext testing support in a TestNG environment.
items.translation: 抽象基测试类，它将 Spring TestContext Framework 与显式的 ApplicationContext 测试支持集成在 TestNG 环境中。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers the Spring infrastructure beans necessary to enable AspectJ-based annotation-driven transaction management for the JTA 1.2 Transactional annotation in addition to Spring's own Transactional annotation.
items.translation: 注册了启用基于 AspectJ 的注解驱动事务管理所需的 Spring 基础设施 bean 的 `@Configuration` 类，除了 Spring 自己的Transactional 注解外，还包括 JTA 1.2 的`Transactional` 注解。

items.source: Simple TransactionAttributeSource implementation that allows attributes to be stored per method in a Map.
items.translation: 简单的 `TransactionAttributeSource` 实现，允许将属性存储在按方法组织的 `Map` 中。

items.source: AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor for declarative transaction management using the common Spring transaction infrastructure (PlatformTransactionManager/ ReactiveTransactionManager).
items.translation: 使用通用 Spring 事务基础设施（PlatformTransactionManager/ ReactiveTransactionManager）进行声明式事务管理的 AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor。

items.source: LocalValidatorFactoryBean subclass that simply turns Validator calls into no-ops in case of no Bean Validation provider being available.
items.translation: LocalValidatorFactoryBean 子类，在不可用任何 Bean Validation 提供程序的情况下，简单地将 Validator 调用转换为空操作。

items.source: A subclass of WebFluxConfigurationSupport that detects and delegates to all beans of type WebFluxConfigurer allowing them to customize the configuration provided by WebFluxConfigurationSupport.
items.translation: 一个 `WebFluxConfigurationSupport` 的子类，用于检测并委托给所有类型为 WebFluxConfigurer 的 Bean，允许它们自定义由 `WebFluxConfigurationSupport` 提供的配置。

items.source: Abstract base class for HandlerMapping implementations that define a mapping between a request and a HandlerMethod.
items.translation: 定义请求与HandlerMethod之间映射的HandlerMapping实现类的抽象基类。

items.source: Convenience subclass of UrlBasedViewResolver that supports ScriptTemplateView and custom subclasses of it.
items.translation: `UrlBasedViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `ScriptTemplateView` 及其自定义子类。

items.source: A subclass of WebMvcConfigurationSupport that detects and delegates to all beans of type WebMvcConfigurer allowing them to customize the configuration provided by WebMvcConfigurationSupport.
items.translation: 一个 `WebMvcConfigurationSupport` 的子类，用于检测并委托给所有类型为 WebMvcConfigurer 的 Bean，允许它们自定义由 `WebMvcConfigurationSupport` 提供的配置。

items.source: Abstract base class for HandlerMapping implementations that define a mapping between a request and a HandlerMethod.
items.translation: 定义请求与HandlerMethod之间映射的HandlerMapping实现类的抽象基类。

items.source: A HandlerExceptionResolver that uses the @ResponseStatus annotation to map exceptions to HTTP status codes.
items.translation: 一个使用 `@ResponseStatus` 注解将异常映射到 HTTP 状态码的 `HandlerExceptionResolver`。

items.source: Abstract base class for HandlerAdapter implementations that support handlers of type HandlerMethod.
items.translation: 支持类型为HandlerMethod的处理器实现的HandlerAdapter抽象基类。

items.source: Convenient superclass for any kind of web content generator, like AbstractController and WebContentInterceptor.
items.translation: 任何类型 Web 内容生成器的便捷父类，例如AbstractController和WebContentInterceptor。

items.translation: `UrlBasedViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `<code>InternalResourceView`（即

items.source: Convenience subclass of UrlBasedViewResolver that supports FreeMarkerView (i.e.
items.translation: `UrlBasedViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `FreeMarkerView`（即

items.source: An extension of Groovy's TemplateConfiguration and an implementation of Spring MVC's GroovyMarkupConfig for creating a MarkupTemplateEngine for use in a web application.
items.translation: Groovy 的 `TemplateConfiguration` 的扩展，以及 Spring MVC 的GroovyMarkupConfig的实现，用于在 Web 应用程序中创建 `MarkupTemplateEngine`。

items.source: Convenience subclass of AbstractTemplateViewResolver that supports GroovyMarkupView (i.e.
items.translation: `AbstractTemplateViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `GroovyMarkupView`（即

items.source: Spring MVC View that renders JSON content by serializing the model for the current request using Jackson 3's JsonMapper.
items.translation: Spring MVC View，它通过利用 Jackson 3 的 JsonMapper 将当前请求的模型序列化为 JSON 内容来渲染视图。

items.source: Convenience subclass of UrlBasedViewResolver that supports ScriptTemplateView and custom subclasses of it.
items.translation: `UrlBasedViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `ScriptTemplateView` 及其自定义子类。

items.source: Spring MVC View that renders XML content by serializing the model for the current request using Jackson 3's XmlMapper.
items.translation: Spring MVC View，它通过序列化当前请求的模型来渲染 XML 内容，使用的是Jackson 3 的XmlMapper。

items.source: Spring-MVC View that allows for response context to be rendered as the result of marshalling by a Marshaller.
items.translation: Spring-MVC 允许将响应上下文作为由 Marshaller 反序列化后的结果进行渲染的 View。

items.source: ViewResolver implementation that resolves instances of XsltView by translating the supplied view name into the URL of the XSLT stylesheet.
items.translation: 实现ViewResolver，通过将提供的视图名称转换为 XSLT 样式表的 URL 来解析XsltView的实例。

items.source: WebSocket connection manager that connects to the server via WebSocketContainer and handles the session with an @ClientEndpoint endpoint.
items.translation: 通过 `WebSocketContainer` 连接到服务器并使用带有`@ClientEndpoint`端点的会话的 WebSocket 连接管理器。

items.source: WebSocket connection manager that connects to the server via WebSocketContainer and handles the session with an Endpoint.
items.translation: 通过 `WebSocketContainer` 连接到服务器并使用 `Endpoint` 处理会话的 WebSocket 连接管理器。

items.source: A WebSocketHandler that initializes and destroys a WebSocketHandler instance for each WebSocket connection and delegates all other methods to it.
items.translation: 一个WebSocketHandler，它为每个 WebSocket 连接初始化并销毁一个WebSocketHandler实例，并将所有其他方法委托给它。

items.source: A default HandshakeHandler implementation, extending AbstractHandshakeHandler with Servlet-specific initialization support.
items.translation: 默认实现HandshakeHandler，扩展了具有 Servlet 特定初始化支持的AbstractHandshakeHandler。

items.source: Extension of SimpleUrlHandlerMapping with support for more precise mapping of WebSocket handshake requests to handlers of type WebSocketHttpRequestHandler.
items.translation: 支持将 WebSocket 握手请求更精确地映射到类型为 WebSocketHttpRequestHandler 的处理器，从而扩展了 SimpleUrlHandlerMapping。

items.source: An HttpRequestHandler that allows mapping a SockJsService to requests in a Servlet container.
items.translation: 一个允许将SockJsService映射到 Servlet 容器中请求的HttpRequestHandler。

items.source: A default implementation of SockJsService with all default TransportHandler implementations pre-registered.
items.translation: 具有所有默认TransportHandler实现预注册的 SockJsService 默认实现。

items.source: Top-level package for the spring-webflux module that contains DispatcherHandler, the main entry point for WebFlux server endpoint processing including key contracts used to map requests to handlers, invoke them, and process the result.
items.translation: `spring-webflux` 模块的顶层包，其中包含 DispatcherHandler，这是 WebFlux 服务器端点处理的主要入口点，包括用于将请求映射到处理器、调用它们并处理结果的关键契约。

items.source: TargetSourceCreator that enforces a LazyInitTargetSource for each bean that is defined as "lazy-init".
items.translation: TargetSourceCreator 为每个定义为“懒加载”的 bean 强制使用 LazyInitTargetSource。

items.source: Basic AutowireCandidateResolver that performs a full generic type match with the candidate's type if the dependency is declared as a generic type (for example, Repository<Customer>).
items.translation: 基本的 AutowireCandidateResolver，如果依赖被声明为泛型类型（例如，Repository<Customer>），则会根据候选者的类型执行完整的泛型类型匹配。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that supports common Java annotations out of the box, in particular the common annotations in the jakarta.annotation package.
items.translation: 支持常见 Java 注解的BeanPostProcessor实现，特别是jakarta.annotation包中的常见注解。

items.source: Post-processor that registers AspectJ's ClassPreProcessorAgentAdapter with the Spring application context's default LoadTimeWeaver.
items.translation: 用于将 AspectJ 的 ClassPreProcessorAgentAdapter 注册到 Spring 应用程序上下文的默认 LoadTimeWeaver 的后处理器。

items.source: Default LoadTimeWeaver bean for use in an application context, decorating an automatically detected internal LoadTimeWeaver.
items.translation: 默认用于应用程序上下文的 `LoadTimeWeaver` Bean，装饰自动检测到的内部 `LoadTimeWeaver`。

items.source: Formats fields annotated with the DurationFormat annotation using the selected style for parsing and printing JSR-310 Duration.
items.translation: 使用所选样式解析和打印 JSR-310 Duration，以格式化带有DurationFormat 注解的字段。

items.source: Formats fields annotated with the DateTimeFormat annotation using the JSR-310 java.time package in JDK 8.
items.translation: 使用 JDK 8 中的 JSR-310 `java.time` 包，格式化带有 `DateTimeFormat` 注解的字段。

items.source: Formats MonetaryAmount fields annotated with Spring's common NumberFormat annotation.
items.translation: 格式化带有 Spring 通用NumberFormat注解的MonetaryAmount字段。

items.source: Creates the necessary MessageListenerContainer instances for the registered endpoints.
items.translation: 创建必要的MessageListenerContainer实例，用于注册的端点。

items.source: MethodInterceptor that routes calls to an MBean running on the supplied MBeanServerConnection.
items.translation: MethodInterceptor 将调用路由到在提供的 MBeanServerConnection 上运行的 MBean。

items.source: PlatformTransactionManager implementation for a single JPA EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 针对单个 JPA EntityManagerFactory 的PlatformTransactionManager实现。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes a shared JPA EntityManager reference for a given EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于暴露给定 EntityManagerFactory 的共享 JPA EntityManager 引用。

items.source: javax.script (JSR-223) based implementation of Spring's ScriptEvaluator strategy interface.
items.translation: `javax.script`(JSR-223) 基于的 Spring `ScriptEvaluator`策略接口实现。

items.source: Abstract transactional extension of AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests which adds convenience functionality for JDBC access.
items.translation: 抽象 `transactional` 扩展的 AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests，它为 JDBC 访问添加了便利功能。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers the Spring infrastructure beans necessary to enable AspectJ-based annotation-driven transaction management for Spring's own Transactional annotation.
items.translation: @Configuration 类注册了启用 Spring 自身 Transactional 注解的基于 AspectJ 的声明式事务管理所需的 Spring 基础设施 Bean。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ServletConfig (typically determined by the WebApplicationContext) that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ServletConfig（通常由 WebApplicationContext 确定）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ServletContext (typically determined by the WebApplicationContext) that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ServletContext（通常由 WebApplicationContext 确定）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: FactoryBean that retrieves a specific ServletContext init parameter (that is, a "context-param" defined in web.xml).
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于获取特定的 ServletContext 初始化参数（即在web.xml中定义的"context-param"）。

items.source: HandlerMapping implementation that supports RouterFunctions.
items.translation: 支持RouterFunctions的HandlerMapping实现。

items.source: A class with an @ExceptionHandler method that handles all Spring WebFlux raised exceptions by returning a ResponseEntity with RFC 9457 formatted error details in the body.
items.translation: 包含 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法的类，该方法处理所有 Spring WebFlux 抛出的异常，并通过返回一个在正文中包含 RFC 9457 格式错误详情的 ResponseEntity 来实现。

items.source: A ViewResolver for resolving FreeMarkerView instances, i.e.
items.translation: 用于解析FreeMarkerView实例的ViewResolver，即

items.source: HandlerMapping implementation that supports RouterFunctions.
items.translation: 支持RouterFunctions的HandlerMapping实现。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that applies initialization and destruction callbacks to beans that implement the Servlet interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 会对实现 Servlet 接口的 bean 应用初始化和销毁回调。

items.source: An AbstractHandlerMethodExceptionResolver that resolves exceptions through @ExceptionHandler methods.

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that takes an interface which must have one or more methods with the signatures MyType xxx() or MyType xxx(MyIdType id) (typically, MyService getService() or MyService getService(String id)) and creates a dynamic proxy which implements that interface, delegating to an underlying BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它接受一个接口，该接口必须包含一个或多个签名为 `MyType xxx()` 或 `MyType xxx(MyIdType id)`（通常是 `MyService getService()` 或 `MyService getService(String id)`）的方法，并创建一个实现该接口的动态代理，委托给底层的一个 `BeanFactory`。

items.source: Convenient subclass of Spring's standard MBeanExporter, activating annotation usage for JMX exposure of Spring beans: ManagedResource, ManagedAttribute, ManagedOperation, etc.
items.translation: Spring 标准 `MBeanExporter` 的便捷子类，激活注解用法以暴露 Spring Bean 到 JMX：`ManagedResource`、`ManagedAttribute`、`ManagedOperation` 等。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which accepts component classes as input — in particular @Configuration classes, but also plain @Component classes as well as JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 实现接受组件类作为输入的WebApplicationContext——特别是@Configuration类，但也包括普通的@Component类以及使用jakarta.inject注解的符合 JSR-330 规范的类。

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that returns a value which is an ObjectFactory that in turn returns a bean sourced from a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它返回一个值为 `ObjectFactory` 的对象，该对象进而返回源自 `BeanFactory` 的 bean。

items.source: Base class for setting up a ExecutorService (typically a ThreadPoolExecutor or ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor).
items.translation: 用于设置 ExecutorService 的基础类（通常是 ThreadPoolExecutor 或 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor）。

items.source: FactoryBean that sets up a ScheduledExecutorService (by default: a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor) and exposes it for bean references.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于配置一个 ScheduledExecutorService（默认情况下：一个 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor），并将其暴露以供 bean 引用。

items.source: as of 5.2, to be removed in 8.0; use org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer instead which is more flexible through taking advantage of the Environment and PropertySource mechanisms.
items.translation: 自 5.2 版本起，将在 8.0 版本中移除；请使用 org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer 替代，它通过利用Environment和PropertySource机制而更加灵活。

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that returns a value which is a JSR-330 Provider that in turn returns a bean sourced from a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它返回一个 JSR-330 `Provider` 值，该值进而返回源自 `BeanFactory` 的 bean。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes all services for the configured service class, represented as a List of service objects, obtained through the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露了配置的服务类的所有服务，表示为通过 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader 设施获取的服务对象列表。

items.source: FactoryBean for a JCache javax.cache.CacheManager, obtaining a pre-defined CacheManager by name through the standard JCache javax.cache.Caching class.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于 JCache javax.cache.CacheManager，通过标准的 JCache javax.cache.Caching 类按名称获取预定义的 CacheManager。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates a JMX 1.2 MBeanServerConnection to a remote MBeanServer exposed via a JMXServerConnector.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建 JMX 1.2 MBeanServerConnection，以连接到通过 JMXServerConnector 暴露的远程 MBeanServer。

items.source: Filter to handle CORS pre-flight requests and intercept CORS simple and actual requests with a CorsProcessor, and to update the response, for example, with CORS response headers, based on the policy matched through the provided CorsConfigurationSource.
items.translation: Filter 用于处理 CORS 预检请求，并通过 CorsProcessor 拦截 CORS 简单和实际请求，同时根据通过提供的 CorsConfigurationSource 匹配的策略更新响应（例如，添加 CORS 响应头）。

items.source: Extract values from "Forwarded" and "X-Forwarded-*" headers, wrap the request and response, and make they reflect the client-originated protocol and address in the following methods: getServerName() getServerPort() getScheme() isSecure() sendRedirect(String).
items.translation: 从 "Forwarded" 和 "X-Forwarded-*" 头中提取值，包装请求和响应，并在以下方法中使其反映客户端发起的协议和地址： getServerName() getServerPort() getScheme() isSecure() sendRedirect(String)。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes the 'primary' service for the configured service class, obtained through the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: FactoryBean 接口，用于暴露配置的服务类对应的'primary'服务，该服务是通过 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader 设施获取的。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader for the configured service class.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露了用于配置的服务类的 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader。

items.source: Convenient base class for ApplicationContext implementations, drawing configuration from XML documents containing bean definitions understood by an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 适用于 `ApplicationContext` 实现的便捷基类，其配置从包含由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 理解的 bean 定义的 XML 文档中读取。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies persistence exception translation to any bean marked with Spring's @Repository annotation, adding a corresponding PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all of the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将持久化异常转换应用于任何标记有 Spring 的 `@Repository` 注解的 bean 的 Bean 后置处理器，向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 `PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor`。

items.source: FactoryBean implementation that takes a list of location Strings and creates a sorted array of Resource instances.
items.translation: FactoryBean 实现，它接收一个位置字符串列表并创建一个排序后的 Resource 实例数组。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any Spring-managed resource that is to be registered with an MBeanServer and wishes to send JMX javax.management.Notifications.
items.translation: 任何由 Spring 管理的、希望注册到 MBeanServer 并发送 JMX javax.management.Notifications 的资源都必须实现的接口。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates a JPA EntityManagerFactory according to JPA's standard container bootstrap contract.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于根据 JPA 标准的 容器 引导契约创建 JPA EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates a JPA EntityManagerFactory according to JPA's standard standalone bootstrap contract.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于根据 JPA 的独立启动标准合同创建 JPA EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates a Hibernate SessionFactory.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建 Hibernate SessionFactory。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that processes PersistenceUnit and PersistenceContext annotations, for injection of the corresponding JPA resources EntityManagerFactory and EntityManager.
items.translation: 处理 `PersistenceUnit` 和 `PersistenceContext` 注解的 BeanPostProcessor，用于注入相应的 JPA 资源 `EntityManagerFactory` 和 `EntityManager`。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies asynchronous invocation behavior to any bean that carries the Async annotation at class or method-level by adding a corresponding AsyncAnnotationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将异步调用行为应用于任何在类或方法级别携带 Async 注解的 Bean 的后处理器，通过向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 AsyncAnnotationAdvisor 来实现。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with @Scheduled to be invoked by a TaskScheduler according to the "fixedRate", "fixedDelay", or "cron" expression provided via the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有 @Scheduled 注解的方法，以便由 TaskScheduler 根据通过注解提供的 "fixedRate"、"fixedDelay" 或 "cron" 表达式进行调用的 Bean 后置处理器。

items.source: JavaBean that allows for configuring a ThreadPoolExecutor in bean style (through its "corePoolSize", "maxPoolSize", "keepAliveSeconds", "queueCapacity" properties) and exposing it as a bean reference of its native ExecutorService type.
items.translation: 允许以 Bean 风格配置 ThreadPoolExecutor（通过其 "corePoolSize"、"maxPoolSize"、"keepAliveSeconds" 和 "queueCapacity" 属性）并将其作为原生类型 ExecutorService 的 Bean 引用暴露出来的 JavaBean。

items.source: JavaBean that allows for configuring a ThreadPoolExecutor in bean style (through its "corePoolSize", "maxPoolSize", "keepAliveSeconds", "queueCapacity" properties) and exposing it as a Spring TaskExecutor.
items.translation: 允许以 Bean 风格配置ThreadPoolExecutor的 JavaBean（通过其"corePoolSize"、"maxPoolSize"、"keepAliveSeconds"、"queueCapacity"属性），并将其作为 SpringTaskExecutor暴露出来。

items.source: A standard implementation of Spring's TaskScheduler interface, wrapping a native ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor and providing all applicable configuration options for it.
items.translation: Spring 的 TaskScheduler 接口的标准实现，封装了原生的 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor，并提供其所有适用的配置选项。

items.source: FactoryBean for creating ThreadPoolTaskExecutor instances, primarily used behind the XML task namespace.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 实例， 主要用于 XML 任务命名空间之后。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes a JobDetail object which delegates job execution to a specified (static or non-static) method.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露一个 JobDetail 对象，该对象将作业执行委托给指定的（静态或非静态）方法。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates and configures a Quartz Scheduler, manages its lifecycle as part of the Spring application context, and exposes the Scheduler as bean reference for dependency injection.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建和配置 Quartz Scheduler，将其生命周期作为 Spring 应用程序上下文的一部分进行管理，并将 Scheduler 暴露为依赖注入的 bean 引用。

items.source: AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext subclass which implements the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface for web environments.
items.translation: 实现`ConfigurableWebApplicationContext`接口的`AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext`子类，用于 Web 环境。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which takes its configuration from Groovy bean definition scripts and/or XML files, as understood by a GroovyBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 一个 `WebApplicationContext` 实现，它从 Groovy bean 定义脚本和/或 XML 文件获取配置，这些文件由 GroovyBeanDefinitionReader 理解。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which takes its configuration from XML documents, understood by an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: `WebApplicationContext` 实现，其配置从 XML 文档中获取，由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 解析。

items.source: Simple base implementation of Filter which treats its config parameters (init-param entries within the filter tag in web.xml) as bean properties.
items.translation: `Filter` 的简单基础实现，将其配置参数（即 `<web.xml>` 中 `<filter>` 标签内的 `<init-param>` 条目）视为 Bean 属性。

items.source: Servlet Filter that exposes the request to the current thread, through both LocaleContextHolder and RequestContextHolder.
items.translation: 暴露当前请求的 Servlet Filter，通过 LocaleContextHolder 和 RequestContextHolder。

items.source: Simple extension of HttpServlet which treats its config parameters (init-param entries within the servlet tag in web.xml) as bean properties.
items.translation: `HttpServlet` 的简单扩展，将其配置参数（即 `<web.xml>` 文件中 `<servlet>` 标签内的 `<init-param>` 条目）视为 Bean 属性。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that creates AOP proxies based on all candidate Advisors in the current BeanFactory.
items.translation: 实现 `BeanPostProcessor` 的代理，基于当前 `BeanFactory` 中的所有候选 `Advisor` 创建 AOP 代理。

items.source: Abstract FactoryBean that creates a local JPA EntityManagerFactory instance within a Spring application context.

items.source: Various TargetSourceCreator implementations for use with Spring's AOP auto-proxying support.
items.translation: 用于与 Spring 的 AOP 自动代理支持配合使用的各种 TargetSourceCreator 实现。

items.translation: 包含用于连接到本地和远程 `MBeanServer` 以及向远程客户端暴露 `MBeanServer` 的支持类。

items.source: Scheduling convenience classes for the java.util.concurrent and jakarta.enterprise.concurrent packages, allowing to set up a ThreadPoolExecutor or ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor as a bean in a Spring context.
items.translation: 为 `java.util.concurrent` 和 `jakarta.enterprise.concurrent` 包中的调度便利类，允许在 Spring 上下文中将 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 或 `ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor` 配置为 Bean。

items.source: Package providing integration of BeanShell (and BeanShell2) into Spring's scripting infrastructure.
items.translation: 提供将 BeanShell（以及 BeanShell2）集成到 Spring 脚本基础设施中的包。

items.source: AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator subclass that processes all AspectJ annotation aspects in the current application context, as well as Spring Advisors.
items.translation: AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator 子类，用于处理当前应用上下文中所有的 AspectJ 注解切面以及 Spring Advisor。

items.source: AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator subclass that exposes AspectJ's invocation context and understands AspectJ's rules for advice precedence when multiple pieces of advice come from the same aspect.

items.source: Base class for asynchronous method execution aspects, such as org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.AnnotationAsyncExecutionInterceptor or org.springframework.scheduling.aspectj.AnnotationAsyncExecutionAspect.
items.translation: 异步方法执行切面的基类，例如`org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.AnnotationAsyncExecutionInterceptor`或`org.springframework.scheduling.aspectj.AnnotationAsyncExecutionAspect`。

items.source: Callback that allows a bean to be aware of the bean class loader; that is, the class loader used by the present bean factory to load bean classes.
items.translation: 允许 Bean 感知其使用的类加载器（即当前 Bean 工厂用于加载 Bean 类的类加载器）的回调；参见 java.lang.ClassLoader。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that autowires annotated fields, setter methods, and arbitrary config methods.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 实现，可自动装配带注解的字段、setter 方法和任意配置方法。

items.source: Simple template superclass for FactoryBean implementations that creates a singleton or a prototype object, depending on a flag.
items.translation: 用于创建单例或原型对象的 `FactoryBean` 实现类的简单模板超类，具体取决于一个标志。

items.source: FactoryBean which retrieves a static or non-static field value.
items.translation: FactoryBean，用于获取静态或非静态字段的值。

items.source: AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext subclass that adds common handling of specified config locations.
items.translation: 继承自AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext的子类，用于添加对指定配置位置的通用处理。

items.source: JMS-specific implementation of the JCA 1.7 MessageEndpointFactory interface, providing transaction management capabilities for a JMS listener object (for example, a MessageListener object).

items.source: Extension of the generic JCA 1.5 GenericMessageEndpointManager, adding JMS-specific support for ActivationSpec configuration.

items.source: Advisor that activates asynchronous method execution through the Async annotation.
items.translation: 通过 `Async` 注解激活异步方法执行的 Advisor。

Support package for declarative messaging configuration,
with Java configuration and XML schema support.

items.translation: 该包为 JMS 消息监听器提供基于 JCA 的端点管理。

items.source:
Provides a MessageConverter abstraction to convert
between Java objects and JMS messages.
items.translation: 提供 MessageConverter 抽象，用于在 Java 对象和 JMS 消息之间进行转换。

items.source: Provides support for accessing remote MBean resources.

This package provides declarative creation and registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans.

Provides supporting infrastructure to allow Spring-created MBeans
to send JMX notifications.
items.translation: 提供支持基础设施，允许 Spring 创建的 MBean 发送 JMX 通知。

items.source:
The classes in this package make JNDI easier to use,
facilitating the accessing of configuration stored in JNDI,
and provide useful superclasses for JNDI access classes.

items.source: Defines interfaces and implementation classes for messaging templates.

Support classes for working with annotated message-handling methods with
non-blocking, reactive contracts.

items.source: Support classes for working with annotated message-handling methods.
items.translation: 支持使用注解的消息处理方法的工作类。

items.source: Common infrastructure for invoking message handler methods.
items.translation: 用于调用消息处理器方法的通用基础设施。

Common infrastructure for invoking message handler methods with non-blocking,
and reactive contracts.
items.translation: 用于以非阻塞和响应式契约调用消息处理器方法的通用基础设施。

items.translation: 用于处理带注解的 RSocket 流处理方法的支持类。

items.source:
Support classes for handling messages from simple messaging protocols
(like STOMP).

items.source:
Provides a "simple" message broker implementation along with an abstract base
class and other supporting types such as a registry for subscriptions.

items.translation: 支持简单消息协议（如 STOMP）的通用功能。

items.source: Package providing integration of JPA (Java Persistence API) with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 提供将 JPA（Java 持久化 API）与 Spring 概念集成的包。

items.source: Hibernate-specific support classes, integrated with JPA.
items.translation: 与 JPA 集成的 Hibernate 专用支持类。

items.source: Internal support for managing JPA persistence units.
items.translation: 用于管理 JPA 持久化单元的内部支持。

items.source: Provides a strategy for looking up R2DBC ConnectionFactories by name.
items.translation: 提供按名称查找 R2DBC ConnectionFactory 的策略。

items.source: Annotation-based retry and concurrency limit support.
items.translation: 基于注解的重试和并发限制支持。

items.source: Annotation support for asynchronous method execution.
items.translation: 支持异步方法执行的注解。

items.source: AspectJ-based scheduling support.
items.translation: 基于 AspectJ 的调度支持。

items.source:
Support package for declarative scheduling configuration,
with XML schema being the primary configuration format.
items.translation: 用于声明式调度配置的辅助包，其中 XML 架构是主要的配置格式。

items.source: Generic support classes for scheduling.
items.translation: 调度用的通用支持类。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's scripting package.

items.source: AOP-based solution for declarative transaction demarcation.
items.translation: 基于 AOP 的声明式事务划分解决方案。

items.source:
Support classes for integrating a JSR-303 Bean Validation provider
(such as Hibernate Validator) into a Spring ApplicationContext
and in particular with Spring's data binding and validation APIs.
items.translation: 支持将 JSR-303 Bean Validation 提供者（例如 Hibernate Validator）集成到 Spring ApplicationContext 中的辅助类，特别是与 Spring 的数据绑定和验证 API 一起使用。

items.source:
Contains a variant of the application context interface for web applications,
and the ContextLoaderListener that bootstraps a root web application context.
items.translation: 包含用于 Web 应用程序的应用程序上下文接口的变体，以及引导根 Web 应用程序上下文的 ContextLoaderListener。

items.source: Support for asynchronous request processing.
items.translation: 支持异步请求处理。

items.source: Provides generic filter base classes allowing for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 提供通用过滤器基类，支持基于 Bean 的配置。

items.source: Support classes for the multipart resolution framework.
items.translation: 支持多部分解析框架的辅助类。

items.source: Spring WebFlux configuration infrastructure.
items.translation: Spring WebFlux 配置基础设施。

items.source: Provides HandlerMapping implementations including abstract base classes.
items.translation: 提供 HandlerMapping 实现，包括抽象基类。

items.translation: 处理器方法处理的底层架构。

items.translation: 基于注解的处理器方法处理的基础设施。

items.source: Support for result handling through view resolution.
items.translation: 支持通过视图解析进行结果处理。

items.source:
Support for creating a registry of HTTP Service client proxies, and declaring
the proxies as beans.
items.translation: 支持创建 HTTP 服务客户端代理的注册表，并将这些代理声明为 Bean。

items.source:
Provides servlets that integrate with the application context
infrastructure, and the core interfaces and classes for the
Spring web MVC framework.
items.translation: 提供与应用程序上下文基础设施集成的 Servlet，以及 Spring Web MVC 框架的核心接口和类。

items.source: Annotation-based setup for Spring MVC.
items.translation: 基于注解的 Spring MVC 配置。

items.source:
Provides standard HandlerMapping implementations,
including abstract base classes for custom implementations.
items.translation: 提供标准的 HandlerMapping 实现，包括用于自定义实现的抽象基类。

items.source:
Standard controller implementations for the Servlet MVC framework that comes with
Spring.
items.translation: Spring 自带的 Servlet MVC 框架的标准控制器实现。

items.source: Support package for annotation-based Servlet MVC controllers.
items.translation: 支持基于注解的 Servlet MVC 控制器的支持包。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's web MVC framework.
items.translation: Spring Web MVC 框架的支持类。

items.source:
Provides standard View and ViewResolver implementations,
including abstract base classes for custom implementations.
items.translation: 提供标准的 View 和 ViewResolver 实现，包括用于自定义实现的抽象基类。

items.source:
Support classes for document generation,
providing View implementations for PDF and Excel.
items.translation: 支持文档生成的类，提供用于 PDF 和 Excel 的视图实现。

items.source: Support classes for feed generation, providing View implementations for Atom and RSS.
items.translation: 用于生成 Feed 的支持类，提供 Atom 和 RSS 的视图实现。

items.source: Support classes for providing a View implementation based on JSON serialization.
items.translation: 用于基于 JSON 序列化提供视图实现的辅助类。

items.translation: 支持基于 XML 反序列化提供 View 实现的类。

items.source:
Support classes for XSLT,
providing a View implementation for XSLT stylesheets.
items.translation: 支持 XSLT 的辅助类，为 XSLT 样式表提供 View 实现。

items.source: Client-side classes for use with standard Jakarta WebSocket endpoints.
items.translation: 用于与标准 Jakarta WebSocket 端点配合使用的客户端类。

items.source: Support for annotation-based WebSocket setup in configuration classes.
items.translation: 支持在配置类中使用基于注解的 WebSocket 设置。

items.source: WebSocket integration for Spring's messaging module.
items.translation: Spring 消息模块的 WebSocket 集成。

items.source: Server-side support for the Jetty WebSocket API.
items.translation: Jetty WebSocket API 的服务器端支持。

items.source: Server-side classes for use with standard JSR-356 WebSocket endpoints.
items.translation: 用于与标准 JSR-356 WebSocket 端点配合使用的服务器端类。

items.source:
Server-side support classes including container-specific strategies
for upgrading a request.
items.translation: 服务器端支持类，包括用于升级请求的特定容器策略。

items.source: Spring AOP Advisor that can be used for any AspectJ pointcut expression.
items.translation: 可用于任何 AspectJ 点切面表达式的 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source:
Generic auto proxy creator that builds AOP proxies for specific beans
based on detected Advisors for each bean.
items.translation: 通用自动代理创建器，它根据每个 Bean 检测到的 Advisor 为特定 Bean 构建 AOP 代理。

items.translation: 自动代理创建器，通过名称列表来识别需要代理的 Bean。

Auto-proxy creator that considers infrastructure Advisor beans only,
ignoring any application-defined Advisors.
items.translation: 仅考虑基础设施 Advisor 的自动代理创建器，忽略任何应用程序定义的 Advisor。

Convenient TargetSourceCreator using bean name prefixes to create one of three
well-known TargetSource types:

: CommonsPool2TargetSource
% ThreadLocalTargetSource
! PrototypeTargetSource
items.translation:
使用 Bean 名称前缀创建三种常见 TargetSource 类型之一的便捷 TargetSourceCreator：

: CommonsPool2TargetSource
% ThreadLocalTargetSource
! PrototypeTargetSource

Abstract BeanFactory-based PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice
to be configured as reference to an Advice bean in a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于抽象 BeanFactory 的切点 Advisor，允许将任何 Advice 配置为 BeanFactory 中 Advice bean 的引用。

Concrete BeanFactory-based PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice
to be configured as reference to an Advice bean in the BeanFactory,
as well as the Pointcut to be configured through a bean property.
items.translation: 基于 Concrete BeanFactory 的 PointcutAdvisor，允许将任何 Advice 配置为 BeanFactory 中 Advice bean 的引用，同时通过 bean 属性配置 Pointcut。

Interface to be implemented by beans that want to be aware of their
bean name in a bean factory.

Abstract base class for property resource configurers that resolve placeholders
in bean definition property values.
items.translation: 用于解析 Bean 定义属性值中占位符的属性资源配置器的抽象基类。

Convenient base class for bean configurers that can perform Dependency Injection
on objects (however they may be created).
items.translation: 适用于 Bean 配置器的便捷基类，该配置器可对对象（无论其如何创建）执行依赖注入。

Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified

A component provider that scans for candidate components starting from a

Convenient superclass for application objects that want to be aware of

or for context-specific resource access.
items.translation: 适用于希望感知应用程序上下文的应用程序对象的便捷父类，例如用于自定义协作 Bean 的查找或用于基于上下文的资源访问。

Standalone XML application context, taking the context definition files

items.translation: 独立 XML 应用程序上下文，从类路径中获取上下文定义文件，将普通路径解释为包含包路径的类路径资源名称（例如，"mypackage/myresource.txt"）。

AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor that provides persistence exception translation

Provides essential configuration for handling messages with simple messaging
protocols such as STOMP.

Servlet Filter that binds a JPA EntityManager to the thread for the
entire processing of the request.
items.translation: 绑定 JPA EntityManager 到线程的 Servlet Filter，用于整个请求处理过程。

Spring web request interceptor that binds a JPA EntityManager to the
thread for the entire processing of the request.

Callback interface to be implemented by Spring-managed

(and optionally the query string) to the Commons Log.

or HTTP-based remote service exporters.

internally.

cache settings.

Adapter base class for template-based view technologies such as FreeMarker,
with the ability to use request and session attributes in their model and
the option to expose helper objects for Spring's FreeMarker macro library.
items.translation: 基于模板视图技术（如 FreeMarker）的适配器基类，支持在模型中使用请求和会话属性，并可选择暴露辅助对象以使用 Spring 的 FreeMarker 宏库。
